confidence.rationale: Deterministic extraction from repository policy files.

procedure: 1. Run `npm run cv:check` before content work.
2. On drift, run `npm run cv:extract` and inspect `.cache/cv-sync/extracted.md` plus `extracted.json`.
3. Update English structured content faithfully, then update Italian and Greek without altering stable IDs, dates, official names, links, or DOI values.
4. Set changed translations to unreviewed and run `npm run test`.
5. After factual review, run `npm run cv:accept`, then `npm run verify`.
rollback: Keep the record as candidate or delete it before promotion.
